segments.name: Mexico
segments.description: Operates two nationally licensed universities in Mexico, serving traditional and non-traditional students with campus-based, online and hybrid undergraduate and graduate degrees.
segments.evidence: In Mexico, the private sector plays a meaningful role in higher education, bridging supply and demand imbalances created by a lack of capacity at public universities.

segments.name: Peru
segments.description: Operates three institutions in Peru offering undergraduate and graduate degrees through campus-based, online and hybrid programs to students.
segments.evidence: Laureate owns three institutions in Peru, with a footprint of 20 campuses.

revenueModel.text: Students and their families pay tuition and fees directly; essentially all revenue comes from private pay sources since there are no material government-sponsored loan programs.
revenueModel.evidence: Essentially all of our revenues were generated from private pay sources as there are no material government-sponsored loan programs in Mexico or Peru.

changes.text: The sale of the Walden Group is reported in discontinued operations, with a 2023 adjustment to its sale price.
changes.evidence: Accordingly, as of December 31, 2023, the Company recorded a liability for this amount through loss on sale of discontinued operations, as it represented an adjustment to the sale price of the Walden Group.
